karta.opisKarty: Realistic window with a day-night blind: animation at motor speed, drag to move, real weather outside and a beginner wizard

edytor.d_kr: The ▲ and ▼ buttons move the blind by a small step. Quick positions are the percentage buttons.
edytor.slh: A fixed mullion stays in the frame. A moving one is part of the left sash, so with both sashes open the middle is free.

edytor.kalh: Manual stopwatch: click, then press “Arrived” when the blind reaches the end. Best from fully open to fully closed.
edytor.globh: Save this look (colours, frame, window, buttons, options) as the default for all blind cards, including new ones. Each card can still change it.
edytor.gSave: 🌍 Save as default for all cards
edytor.gIle: Saved globally: {0} settings. All cards use them.
edytor.gBrak: No global settings – cards use the defaults.

edytor.czA: 🔎 Detected automatically (left / right): {0}. Manual choice above takes priority.

edytor.krs: One tap ▲/▼ moves the blind by

edytor.ak0: Moving the blind to the top…

zr: HA entity, internet if there is none

osld: Solid and sheer stripes. Slide them to let light through the sheer stripes.
A plain roller of solid fabric. Diffuses the light.
Dense coated fabric. Runs in white side channels and blocks the light.
Double pleat. Honeycomb cells keep the warmth in.
Thin 25 mm aluminium slats on cords.
Wide 50 mm wooden slats on tapes.
Box above the window in the frame colour, fitted with the window. Curtain of PVC or aluminium profiles.
Box on the outside wall with a bevelled front. Good for existing houses.
Box hidden in the wall under the plaster. Only the curtain and guides are visible.
Profiles with small holes. Some light comes in when closed.
Curved 80 mm aluminium slats on tapes. They can tilt.
Flat 90 mm Z-shaped slats with a seal. Very dark when closed.
Outside mesh fabric in zipped side guides. Keeps the sun out, keeps the view.
edytor.urz: 🔗 This window comes from the HA Window integration – every change is saved to the device automatically (same as “Configure”).

roleta.co: the blind or blind group this card shows and controls. Only blinds are listed – no gates, garage doors or other devices.
roleta.poco: the card sends it commands (open, close, set %) and draws its real position.

okno.co: how many sashes the window has and which blind hangs on which sash.
okno.poco: each sash on the card moves together with its real blind.

silnik.co: an entity with the motor speed (rpm), if your motor reports it (e.g. Moes, Tuya). Only speed entities are listed.
silnik.poco: the animation moves exactly at the speed of the real blind. Without it the card learns the time by itself.

czujniki.co: contact sensors of the window – left and right sash separately. Only window, door and opening sensors are listed.
czujniki.poco: when you tilt or open the window, the card shows it. This step is optional.

pogoda.co: where the card takes the weather from.
pogoda.poco: you see the real sky behind the glass: sun, clouds, rain, snow, night and the temperature.

wyglad.co: a ready-made set of frame and blind colours and the name on the card.
wyglad.poco: so the card looks like your window. You can change every colour later in 🎨 Look.

gdzie.co: a summary of what the card found and where it should appear.
gdzie.poco: so nothing is left to fix. If something needs doing, it says what and where.

kreator.jednaNaDwa: One blind for two sashes: both halves on the card move together. If each sash has its own blind, pick them below or create a group: Settings → Devices & services → Helpers → “+ Create helper” → Group → Cover group.
kreator.rpmOk: {0}: motor {1} rpm → full travel approx. {2} s
kreator.rpmBrak: {0}: the motor does not report speed – no problem, the card learns the travel time from the first moves.
kreator.rpmZadnej: There is no motor speed entity in HA. That is normal for most motors – the card learns the travel time by itself. Want it now? Measure it with the button below.
kreator.kal: 🤖 Measure the time now (the blind goes up → down → up)
kreator.czBrak: There are no window sensors in HA (binary sensor of type window, door or opening). You can skip this step – the card works without them.
kreator.czBezPom: The blind has no room (area), so the wizard cannot tell which sensors are in the same room. Assign a room to the blind’s device (Settings → Devices → blind → ✏️ → Area) for better matches.
kreator.czAuto: Sensors picked automatically from the same room. You can choose others.

kreator.wxBezLok: HA does not know your home location, so internet weather will not work. Set it: Settings → System → General → pin on the map.
kreator.wxNiedost: “{0}” is unavailable – check the weather integration. Until it is fixed the card uses internet weather.
kreator.wxNic: Without weather the glass shows a plain day / night sky.
